Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of Work A. Design, Fabrication and Installation of 3D SS GRID-INDIA Logo at Reception Area, GRID-INDI

A. Design, Fabrication and Installation of 3D SS GRID-INDIA Logo at Reception Area, GRID-INDI A Bhawan, Ayurvigyan Nagar, New Delhi. 1. Work Description: Design, fabrication, supply and installation of 3D GRID-INDIA logo in SS 304 Grade stainless steel finished in the actual colours of the GRID-INDIA logo, at the designated space on the existin g aluminium-panel wall of the reception area at GRID-INDIA Bhawan, as per the approved artwork and site requirements. 2. Technical Specifications: The 3D logo shall be fabricated using SS 304 Grade stainless steel, letters with a thickness of 1.2 mm sheet for the front face and side walls, and a depth of 1.5 inch. The logo shall b e finished in the actual/approved colours of the GRID-INDIA logo. The logo shall have a precision-cut front f ace, neatly welded joints, smooth edges and a uniform brushed/matt finish/glossy. The overall size shall be approximately 10 ft × 5 ft (W × H), subject to approved design and measurements. 3. Installation: The logo shall be securely mounted on the already installed aluminium-panel structure/w all at the designated location using suitable concealed SS 304 Grade fasteners, mounting brackets/studs a nd high-strength industrial-grade adhesive, as appropriate. The installation shall ensure proper alignment, fixing, structural stability and a neat, seamless appearance. B. Design, Fabrication and Installation of 3D GRID-INDIA Logo & “NATIONAL LOAD DESPATCH CENTRE” Signage 1. Work Description: Supply, fabrication and installation of 3D wall-mounted GRID-INDIA signage co mprising the GRID-INDIA logo in its original approved colours, a 3D horizontal SS line below the GRID-I NDIA logo, and “NATIONAL LOAD DESPATCH CENTRE” in 3D SS 304 Grade letters with brushed/matt fini sh, maintaining the approved design, proportions, uniform depth and smooth finish. 2. Technical Specifications: The signage shall be fabricated using SS 304 Grade SS, 1.2 mm thick SS sh eet with precision-cut front face and 1.5 inch side wall, with finish (brushed/matt) as per approved artwork. The letters shall be individually fabricated with uniform thickness/depth, smooth edges and seamless joints , providing a premium architectural appearance. Overall size of signage shall be 14 ft × 5 ft, maintaining t he approved design, proportions, uniform depth and smooth finish. 3. Installation: The signage shall be securely mounted on the wall at the designated location using suita ble concealed SS 304 Grade fasteners, mounting brackets/studs and high-strength industrial-grade adhesi ve, as appropriate. The installation shall ensure proper alignment, fixing, civil work, structural stability and a neat, seamless appearance. C. Design, Fabrication and Installation of SS 304 Directional Signage Board at Main Entrance, GRID-INDIA Bhawan, Ayurvigyan Nagar, New Delhi 1. Work Description: Design, supply, fabrication, transportation and installation of a directional signage board in SS 304 Grade stainless steel at the main entrance of GRID-INDIA Bhawan, displaying the Compan y name, logo, address, directional arrows and other relevant details, as per the approved artwork. 2. Technical Specifications: The signage board shall be fabricated using 1.5 mm thick SS 304 Grade sh eet, with an overall size of 8 ft × 4 ft, a brushed/matt finish and an SS 304 outer frame of 1.5" × 1.5" secti on and 1.5 mm thickness. All text, logo, border and directional arrows shall be chemically etched/engrave d and colour-filled using durable, weather-resistant paint/enamel in approved colours. The board shall hav e neatly welded joints, smooth edges and rounded corners.

3. Support Structure and Installation: The board shall be mounted on SS 304 Grade vertical support p oles of 3" × 3" section, 1.5 mm thickness and approximately 8 ft height, securely fixed to the existing wall/ structure using suitable mounting plates, heavy-duty anchor fasteners and other necessary hardware. The mounting arrangement shall ensure proper alignment, structural stability and resistance to applicable win d loads. 4. General Requirements: The scope shall include site measurement, preparation and submission of dr awings/artwork for approval, fabrication, engraving, finishing, transportation, civil works, all necessary mo unting hardware, installation and cleaning, complete in all respects. The vendor shall obtain prior approval of the artwork, dimensions, drawings and mounting arrangement from GRID-INDIA and ensure the structur al suitability of the mounting surface. All materials shall be of the specified quality, and the completed wor k shall carry a minimum one-year warranty against manufacturing and installation defects. D. Delivery: The delivery & installation of all the items, i.e., 3D SS GRID-INDIA Logo signages and Directional Signage Board, shall be completed within 30 days from the date of issuance of the Letter of Aw ard (LoA). E. Officer-in-Charge: Dy. General Manager (HR) or his/her authorized representative shall be the Officer- in-Charge for this contract. F. Location: Grid Controller of India Limited, GRID-INDIA Bhawan, Ayurvigyan Nagar, August Kranti Marg, New Delhi – 110049. G. Site Survey: Bidders may visit the GRID-INDIA premise to conduct the site survey for all the signage b oard/logos. H. Payment Terms: 100% payment shall be made within 15 days upon verification and certification by th e Officer-in-Charge or their authorized representative, after successful completion of Design, Fabrication a nd Installation. Payment will be processed by the Finance & Accounts Department at CC, GRID-INDIA, New Delhi. Statutory Deduction as applicable shall be made. Payment to MSME: Payment to all MSME shall be released through TReDS portal as per Gazette notificat ion dated 30 June 2026. GRID-INDIA is registered on following TReDS (Trade Receivables Discounting System) platforms and the fa cility of the same shall be availed by Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) for payment: a. A-TReDS (www.invoicemart.com) b. RXIL (https://www.rxil.in/). c. M1xchange (https://www.m1xchange.com) d. C2treds (https://c2treds.com) e. DTX (https://www.dtxindia.in/)

I. Safety of Personnel: The Contractor shall be responsible for the safety of their staff and workers while working in our premises against all accidents, damages or loss of life. It shall be their responsibility to im mediately arrange for hospitalization, medical attendance in case of any accident or loss of life and it shall be their responsibility to meet the expenditure of such loss or accidents and to compensate for and / or arr ange Insurance Coverage to their personnel. GRID-INDIA shall not sustain any responsibility due to any da mage suffered by their personnel on above grounds. However, agency shall take utmost care towards safe ty of their personnel working in our premises. J. Observance of Labour Laws: The Contractor shall be liable to make payment to all its employees and make compliance with labour laws. If GRID-INDIA is held as “PRINCIPLE EMPLOYER” to pay contribution etc. under E.S. Act or any other legislation of Government or Court decision in respect of you, then you would r eimburse such contributions pre-paid by GRID-INDIA. K. Approval of Design: Upon award of the contract, the successful bidder shall submit the draft design f or approval by the Engineer-in-Charge before proceeding with fabrication. Technical Specifications There are some differences in some specification given under head “As per GeM Category Specification-standard” and “Additional Spe cification Parameters”. In such cases bidders are requested to cons ider and comply the specifications given under the head “Additiona l Specification Parameters” and the specifications as given below: A. 3D GRID-INDIA Logo signage at Reception Area 1. Thickness of Signage Material - 1.2 mm thick SS 304 Grade sheet with a letter depth of 1.5 inches 2. Frame Material: Stainless Steel (SS) 3. Shape of Signage Board: Rectangular, as per logo design and dimensions 4. Type of Signage Board: Non-illuminated (Glossy/Matt finish) 5. Lighting: Without lighting 6. Material of Signage Board: Stainless Steel (SS 304 Grade) 7. Mounting Type: Wall-mounted on existing aluminium panel wall

8. Dimensions of Signage: 3D GRID-INDIA Logo (Coloured) : 10 ft × 5 ft (W × H) B. 3D GRID-INDIA Logo, 3D horizontal SS line and “NATIONAL LOAD DESPATCH CENTRE at Seco nd floor 1. Thickness of Signage Material: 1.2 mm thick SS 304 Grade sheet with a letter depth of 1.5 inches 2. Frame Material: Stainless Steel (SS) 3. Shape of Signage Board: Rectangular (GRID-INDIA logo in its original approved colours, a 3D horizo ntal SS line below the GRID-INDIA logo, and “NATIONAL LOAD DESPATCH CENTRE” in 3D letters) 4. Type of Signage Board: Non-illuminated 5. Lighting: Without lighting 6. Material of Signage Board: Stainless Steel (SS 304 Grade) 7. Mounting Type: Wall-mounted 8. Dimensions of Signage: 3D GRID-INDIA Logo, horizontal SS line and “NATIONAL LOAD DESPATCH CE NTRE” Signage: 14 ft × 5 ft (W × H). C. Signage at main gate entrance 1. Thickness of Signage Material: 1.5 mm thick SS 304 Grade sheet 2. Frame Material: Stainless Steel (SS) 3. Shape of Signage Board: Rectangular with outer frame 4. Type of Signage Board: Non-illuminated 5. Lighting: Without lighting

6. Material of Signage Board: Stainless Steel (SS 304 Grade) 7. Mounting Type: Ground mounted on supporting poles 8. Dimensions of Signage : Board size: 8 ft × 4 ft (W × H); supporting pole height: 8 ft. D. Drawing: The Indicative designs of all the three signages/logos have been attached in Bid Specific ATC document for reference purpose. Bidders are requested to ignore the Appli cable Drawing Documents attached under the heads “Additional Specification Documents”. . 3.
